summary: Tested new Appearance panel: backend theme extended-fields persistence and frontend live-apply on admin + portfolio. All 14 new theme fields (font_family, animations_enabled, animation_speed, cursor_style, scrollbar_style, background_style, glass_effect, shadow_intensity, card_style, container_width, navbar_style, loader_enabled, background_override, text_override) persist via PUT /api/admin/theme and are returned by GET /api/theme. On the admin Appearance tab all 45+ expected data-testids render (5 light + 5 dark full presets, 6 legacy color presets, 7 fonts, animation toggle+3 speed pills, 3 cursors, 4 scrollbars, 5 bg styles, 4 card styles, glass toggle, 3 shadows, 3 navbar styles, 4 container widths, loader toggle, custom colors, radius, button styles, save/reset). Live preview works for every option — clicking Dracula flips <html data-theme='dark'>, --accent to #FF79C6, --bg to #282A36 and font var to Poppins. Save persists to server; refreshing portfolio home reflects all overrides (data-cursor='glow', data-bg-style='grid', data-card-style='outline', data-navbar-style='transparent', data-animations='off', data-glass='on', --container-max=1600px, --font-family='Poppins ...') and the CustomCursor element with data-testid='app-cursor' renders. Loader disabled → portfolio-loading testid does NOT appear during load. Theme was RESTORED to Modern light preset at end so the site remains presentable (mode=light, preset=light:Modern, loader on, cursor default). No console errors observed. 2/2 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: AppearanceTab.jsx is ~375 lines and mixes preset dictionaries, pill helpers, and layout — consider extracting FULL_PRESETS to /lib/presets.js and PillGroup/Row to shared components for reuse.

theme.jsx applyTheme() uses background_override / text_override to fully override background+text colors, but background_alt has no matching *_override handling for dark presets — Dracula and Nord will use the default dark #141416 bg-alt rather than a darker variant of the preset bg. Minor visual, not blocking.

CustomCursor over-handler mutates el.style.transform by concatenating ' scale(1.8)' onto the existing translate string; on subsequent mousemoves the scale is lost. Works cosmetically but the scale-on-hover intent isn't durable — set transform via a CSS class or store scale in a separate variable and combine in a single write.
No debounce/throttle on live preview applyTheme — clicking pills repeatedly writes to CSS vars synchronously; acceptable given cost is low.

loader_enabled default handling in AppearanceTab spreads defaults then `...current` which is correct, but a saved theme with loader_enabled=false will now correctly override; good. Just note: any missing field on the server will fall back to admin-side defaults, which could silently 'reset' fields on next save.

success_rate.backend: 100% (2/2 new theme tests + prior 28/29 still passing)

seed_data_creation: Theme mutated during testing then RESTORED to Modern light preset (preset=light:Modern, mode=light, font=DM Sans, loader on, cursor default). Portfolio visually normal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme endpoint stores arbitrary fields — no schema. New Appearance testids listed in prior request are all wired. Do NOT run test_theme_appearance in parallel with other theme-mutating tests unless you restore afterwards; the final `test_restore_modern_light_theme` in the suite handles cleanup. Portfolio custom cursor only renders when theme.cursor_style is 'dot' or 'glow'.
